kaikki_vikisozluk.e: مَسِيحَانِيّ • (masīḥāniyy) (feminine مَسِيحَانِيَّة (masīḥāniyya), masculine plural مَسِيحَانِيُّون (masīḥāniyyūn), feminine plural مَسِيحَانِيَّات (masīḥāniyyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: مَسِيح (masīḥ, “Messiah, Christ”) + ـِيّ (-iyy), with the infix to distinguish it from مَسِيحِيّ (masīḥiyy, “Christian”).
